infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Thrive uses your photo library so you can choose meal photos, progress photos, or the photo for the optional AI body scan. Meal and body-scan photos are sent to an AI service only after you allow AI features.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Thrive uses the camera to photograph meals for nutrition logging, take progress photos, and take the photo for the optional AI body scan. Meal and body-scan photos are sent to an AI service only after you allow AI features.
